title: EXT-001 — Public Reproduction of a QPF Verification Identity (OpenZeppelin Ownable.sol @ 932fddf, v5.0.0)

derivation.qpfv0: sha256(jcs_rfc8785_canonicalize(stable_result_fields)) where stable = { spec, target, level_requested, level_achieved, status, checks, verifier, evidence_binding } — excludes timestamp, summary, does_not_authorize
derivation.jcs_note: JSON Canonicalization Scheme (RFC 8785): object keys sorted by Unicode code point, no insignificant whitespace, ECMAScript JSON string/number forms, raw UTF-8 (non-ASCII not escaped)
derivation.source: Algorithms from src/verification/result-id.js and src/verification/package.js in the QPF repository
